parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: NetworkInstanceId
parameters.description: The VPC instance ID used to create a VPC firewall.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.

> You can invoke the [DescribeVpcFirewallCenList](~~345777~~) operation to query the instance ID of the VPC firewall.
